# Charlotte Country Day School — Branding — Athletics Logo

**Provenance:** Fetched by Claude on 2026-07-25 via web research, to add the school's
athletics mascot logo to the school-page header in the app.

- **School:** Charlotte Country Day School (Charlotte, NC)
- **Mascot / teams:** Buccaneers
- **Athletic colors:** Green & gold (nchslogos lists teal #00664A & gold #FFC658)
- **Logo used in app:** `public/logos/charlotte-country-day.png` — primary Buccaneers
 mark (a green pirate/buccaneer flag with sword, interlocking "CD" monogram). 1200×800
 PNG, transparent background.
